name: Kenjo
niche: HR software with applicant tracking for SMEs
notes: Workforce management software with per-employee monthly pricing (6.0 and 10.0 euros shown). Recruiting module includes a native integration to post jobs to 100+ job boards. Open API is offered to software partners.
